.NET Backend Developer

About the role
We are a growing product company building web platforms for logistics customers. We are hiring a backend
developer to join a small engineering team.

Responsibilities
- Design, develop and maintain REST APIs for our customer-facing platform.
- Develop and optimize database objects and queries.
- Integrate internal services with third-party APIs.
- Maintain and enhance existing software, fixing defects and improving performance.
- Debug production issues and provide technical support.
- Write clean, tested, maintainable code and take part in code reviews.

Required Skills
- C#
- ASP.NET Core
- .NET
- SQL Server
- REST APIs

Experience
- 3+ years of professional experience building backend services

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred Skills
- Azure
- Docker
- Angular

Benefits
- Flexible working hours
- Learning budget
